claims.text: The Office of the Speaker's release issued 10 December 2024 states that Speaker Lord Fakafanua issued invitations 'today' to all Elected Representatives to nominate an Elected Representative as candidate for Prime Minister Designate, following the vacancy in the Office of the Prime Minister due to the resignation of former Prime Minister Hon. Hu'akavameiliku (Siaosi 'Ofa ki Vahafolau Sovaleni) on Monday 9 December 2024; nominations close at 4.30pm on Monday 23 December 2024, and the meeting of all Elected Representatives to elect the Prime Minister Designate is to be held on Tuesday 24 December 2024.
